modules.name: Announcement, Event, Registration, and Attendance Management
Reports, Dashboard Analytics, and Goal Monitoring
Cross-Layer System Administration and Role-Based Access Control

submit_application.label: Submit application
submit_application.help: Upload required documents to your saved draft before submitting.

request_renewal.label: Submit renewal information
request_renewal.help: Save a draft and attach all configured renewal requirements before submitting.

record_attendance.label: Record manual attendance
record_attendance.help: Manual fallback and corrections require an explanation.

create_election.label: Configure election
create_election.help: Proposal defaults: announce 4 weeks before third-term end, candidacy +3 days, voting +7 days, results within +3 days, 60% turnout, 2 consecutive completed terms. Validate the club rules before opening.

nominate_candidate.label: Nominate a member
nominate_candidate.help: The election officer reviews eligibility before the nomination appears on the ballot.

record_leadership.label: Record appointment or turnover
record_leadership.help: This records the decision. Assign or retire system permissions separately in M14.

save_personal_training.label: Save personal scorecard
save_personal_training.help: Personal entries remain distinct from official coach-validated records.

review_training_correction.label: Resolve training correction
review_training_correction.help: For approval, the corrected scorecard is included in this transaction.

save_financial_request.label: Save payment, expense or reimbursement
save_financial_request.help: Save a draft, attach proof or receipts, then submit. The app records transactions; it does not move money.

invite_account.label: Create account and send invitation
invite_account.help: This sends an invitation email. The recipient verifies the invitation code and chooses a password. It does not grant membership or officer permissions.

invite_partner.label: Invite registered representative
invite_partner.help: The representative first registers and verifies their account. This invitation gives access only to this event.
